LESSON: CONVERSATIONAL SKILLS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.7: Conversational Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Conversational Skills
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do you take care of your body?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations
2. apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations
• Model 2: apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations
2. Practise: apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Conversational Skills.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you take care of your body?
2. Why should we observe etiquette in conversations?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify polite words used to interrupt in conversations
• apply appropriate etiquette and turn taking skills in conversations

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
